title: Zephyr devicetree binding
description: Structure and key descriptions only. Which keys are allowed is checked by the Zephyr Bindings language server with the rules of the workspace's edtlib.py (ARCHITECTURE D23), so unknown keys are not errors here.

title.description: Short one-line summary of the hardware.

description.description: What the hardware is; shown in generated documentation.

include.description: Bindings to merge into this one: a file name, a list of names, or entries with filters.

property-allowlist.description: Only these properties of the included binding are used.

property-blocklist.description: These properties of the included binding are dropped.

bus.description: Bus type(s) this node provides to its children, e.g. i2c or spi.

on-bus.description: This binding only matches nodes on a parent bus of this type.

child-binding.description: Binding applied to every child node of a matching node.

-cells$.description: Names of the cells of a specifier for this controller (gpio-cells, clock-cells, …).

type.description: Value type: boolean, int, array, uint8-array, string, string-array, phandle, phandles, phandle-array, path, compound.

required.description: The property must be set on every matching node.

default.description: Value used when the node does not set the property.

deprecated.description: Warn when a node sets this property.

specifier-space.description: Specifier space of a phandle-array whose name does not end in the space name (e.g. foo-gpios uses gpio).
